title: Magnetic-Bead cDNA Template Switch Reaction

steps.source_text: Place each tube of captured cDNA from Section 2.1 on the high position of the magnetic rack.
steps.execution_notes: A high-position rack confirmation gates magnetic processing.

steps.source_text: Incubate until the solution clears, about 2 minutes.
steps.execution_notes: Standalone magnetic sep preserves the original physical tube; explicit bound fates plus existing material rules retain bead-bound cDNA. Clarity input gates removal.

steps.source_text: While still on the magnetic rack, remove and discard the supernatant.
steps.execution_notes: Discard only after clarity passes, including one authored 1-minute wait/recheck if needed.

steps.source_text: While still on the magnetic rack, add 125 uL of Wash Buffer 3 to each tube. Do not discard the Wash Buffer 3 as it will be used in another step.
steps.execution_notes: Keep the original WB3 reminder distinct from the author interpretation to save unused reagent; the in-sample wash is discarded at step 7.

steps.source_text: Incubate for 1 minute at room temperature.
steps.execution_notes: Keep the 1-minute room-temperature magnetic wash; an additional clarity check gates its removal.

steps.source_text: While still on the magnetic rack, remove and discard Wash Buffer 3.
steps.execution_notes: A failed wash-clarity recheck stops dependent operations without discarding the wash.

steps.source_text: Remove the tube(s) from the magnetic rack.
steps.execution_notes: Confirm removal from the magnetic rack before resuspension.

steps.source_text: Fully resuspend each bead pellet with 100 uL of the Template Switch Master Mix. Because the mix is viscous, full resuspension may take time.
steps.execution_notes: Use the 100uL source recipe and authored 10x80uL mixing, then a suspension readout; one 10-stroke retry is allowed.

steps.source_text: Briefly centrifuge without letting beads collect at the bottom of the tube(s).
steps.execution_notes: Executable authored 100g/8s centrifuge retains the supernatant in the source tube. Explicit transitions release field retention of beads while preserving cDNA-bead binding.

steps.source_text: Incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature.
steps.execution_notes: Run the source 30-minute room-temperature hold only after prior checks pass.

steps.source_text: Fully resuspend each bead pellet by mixing 5x with a P200 set to 75 uL.
steps.execution_notes: Execute five 75uL strokes and check resuspension; an authored 10-stroke retry is available.

steps.source_text: Place the tube(s) into a thermocycler and run the Template Switch program.
steps.execution_notes: Confirm 70C lid and 100uL sample setting, then 42C/60min and common 4C Hold. Finite 10min Hold is authored.

steps.source_text: Proceed immediately to Section 2.3, or proceed to original step 14 below for storage before cDNA amplification.
steps.execution_notes: Branch only after the common 4C Hold; record processing stage without creating a new DNA identity.

steps.source_text: For optional storage, place the tube(s) on the high position of the magnetic rack and incubate until the solution clears, about 2 minutes. Beads may need to be resuspended if settled.
steps.execution_notes: Check for settled beads, resuspend/recheck if needed, confirm high position, then clear about 2min.

steps.source_text: While still on the magnetic rack, remove and discard the supernatant.
steps.execution_notes: A clear-supernatant readout, with one authored 1-minute retry if needed, gates discard.

steps.source_text: Remove the tube(s) from the magnetic rack.
steps.execution_notes: Confirm removal from magnetic rack before WB2 addition.

steps.source_text: Fully resuspend each bead pellet with 125 uL Wash Buffer 2.
steps.execution_notes: 125uL WB2 and authored 10x100uL strokes, followed by resuspension confirmation/retry.

steps.source_text: Template-switched cDNA can be stored at 4C for up to 18 hours. Do not freeze.
steps.execution_notes: Confirm 4C, no freezing and at most 18h. Mark storage complete only after prior checks and storage finish.

source_version: Evercode WT Mega v3; UMWT3500; version 1.5; November 2024
